purpose: Descriptive runtime, memory, output-size, integrity and failure calibration; excluded from subsequent confirmatory samples.
hypotheses: Increasing simulations changes adoption of legal G0 routes; monotonicity is not assumed.
G0 rules and MCTS choice/rollout semantics remain unchanged; only equal per-player simulations varies.
seed_mapping: For each batch_seed and identity/orientation/repetition, use existing game_seed_for(batch_seed, ((identity_index*2+orientation_index)*games_per_cell+repeat_index)); reuse identical game seed across budgets. Existing colour+agent seed RNG derivation unchanged. Budget-specific trajectories diverge and are paired, not independent.
execution_order: budget ascending, batch_seed listed order, identity listed order, orientation listed order, replicate ascending
fixed_factors: G0 5x5, black first, white komi2.5, area scoring, no suicide, situational superko with pass exemption, double pass, 100-ply limit
Original vector utility MCTS, c=sqrt(2), uniform rollout including pass, no tree reuse, random maximum-visit ties
Same simulations for black and white; no cross-budget matches; representative seeds1,2 not population claims
primary_endpoints: wall/CPU time and peak RSS by budget; distribution of per-game/per-move times and output bytes
failed games, unplanned interruptions, validation failures, recovery outcomes
descriptive_behavior_endpoints: LL black all-pass route and black/white goals
LW exact empty double-pass; WL exact one-black-stone double-pass; mixed joint goal count
first pass and proposal immediate utilities/acceptance, captures, raw and END-padded4/8/12 prefixes
paired budget differences and individual seed counts with denominators; representative min/median/max and anomalous games selected deterministically
statistics: No p-values, no efficacy decision, no outcome-driven stopping or ordinary CI optional stopping. Each budget×identity has6 games across3 seeds. Report individual seeds and pooled counts; games sharing seeds across budgets are paired. Resource forecasts only; not evidence of convergence.
expansion_rule: None within this calibration. Stop after exactly72 validated games. Recommend a separately preregistered fixed-sample direction pilot based on measured costs, without reusing these games; next phase requires new seeds and explicit sampling/paired analysis plan.

stop_conditions: estimated remaining calibration exceeds12hours without supporting pilot evidence
unexpected resource pressure or baseline alteration

resume and concurrency determinism excluding timing in tests

official per-game persistence and deliberate6-game resume checkpoint
